answerCaution: The AI can be wrong: check figures against the sheet.
askNote.range: Data sent: {sent}{headers, select, one { and its header {headerRange}} many { and its headers {headerRange}} other {}} on {sheet}, values as shown, with the names of the sheets, tables, and named ranges.
askNote.rangeCut: Data sent: {sent} (the first {rows} rows and {cols} columns of {whole}){headers, select, one { and its header {headerRange}} many { and its headers {headerRange}} other {}} on {sheet}, values as shown, with the names of the sheets, tables, and named ranges.
askNote.sheet: Data sent: {sent} (the sheet's data; select cells first to ask about part of it) on {sheet}, values as shown, with the names of the sheets, tables, and named ranges.
askNote.sheetCut: Data sent: {sent} (the first {rows} rows and {cols} columns of the sheet's data {whole}; select cells first to ask about part of it) on {sheet}, values as shown, with the names of the sheets, tables, and named ranges.
askPlaceholder: e.g. Which category is most over budget? Summarize these expenses in two sentences.
cellProtected: {cell} is protected. Unprotect it before inserting the result.
couldNotAskUnknown: Could not ask the AI: unknown error
dataNote.headers: Data sent: headers in {headers} on {name}, values as shown, with the names of the sheets, tables, and named ranges.
dataNote.headersRow: Data sent: headers in {headers} and row {row} of {columns} on {name}, values as shown, with the names of the sheets, tables, and named ranges.
dataNote.headersRows: Data sent: headers in {headers} and rows {from}–{to} of {columns} on {name}, values as shown, with the names of the sheets, tables, and named ranges.
dataNote.noData: Data sent: only the names of the sheets, tables, and named ranges; {name} has no data.
failsValidation: This result does not meet the cell’s validation rule.
formulaCaution: Check it before you use it: the AI can be wrong.
formulaHidden: The formula in {cell} is hidden while the sheet is protected.
formulaPlaceholder: e.g. total of Planned where Category is Rent, or the number of days until the due date in C2
inArray: {cell} is part of the array formula in {range}, which can only be changed as a whole. Select another cell and ask again.
noData: There is no data on this sheet to ask about.
noFormula: The reply held no formula. Try describing it differently.
sheetGone: The destination sheet no longer exists.
typeFormula: Type what the formula should calculate
typeQuestion: Type a question about the data
written: {kind, select, answer {Answer written into {cell}} other {Formula written into {cell}}}
